title: Returned Payment Fee and Certified-Funds Restriction Schedule (Kestrel Advantage Balloon)
content:
For the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the company sets a returned-payment fee before the contract's state maximum is applied, a count of returned payments that triggers a certified-funds-only restriction, the lookback over which returns are counted and the length of the restriction.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Company returned-payment fee before the state maximum (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Returned payments within the lookback that trigger the restriction (count) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Lookback for counting returned payments (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Length of a certified-funds-only restriction (calendar months) | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

## Notes

- The figures are identical across Tier 5 through Tier 1+.
- The company fee of USD 25.00 is a figure before the contract's recorded state maximum is applied; the state maximum is a contract record, not a tier figure.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a contract with 2 returned payments inside a 12 calendar month lookback has reached the restriction count.
